versions.changelog:
- Skill renamed from "moltbot, openclaw-best-practices" to "moltbot-best-practices"
- Description and keywords updated for clarity and broader tool coverage (now mentions ChatGPT, Copilot, GitHub Copilot, developer/dev tools, TypeScript, LLM)
- Minor text and formatting tweaks for conciseness and consistency in SKILL.md
- Version bumped to 1.1.3
SEO update: added claude-code, copilot, agentic keywords
Added recommended config for memory flush and session memory search

- Initial release of "moltbot-best-practices": a guide to help AI agents avoid common mistakes and adopt proven best practices.
- Covers 15 key rules including: confirming tasks before action, never publishing without approval, stopping immediately when told, avoiding over-automation, and processing messages in order.
- Provides quick reference and anti-pattern lists for easy adoption.
- Originates from real-world failures to help agents act more reliably and align with user expectations.
